description: Defines the class ocudu::pdcp_rx_metrics for collecting and managing reception metrics in a PDCP layer, including methods for adding various metrics, retrieving, and resetting them.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_metrics
classes.description: A class for collecting and managing reception metrics related to PDCP layer processing.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: add_sdus
methods.description: Adds SDU count and size metrics.

methods.name: add_pdus
methods.description: Adds PDU count and size metrics.

methods.name: add_data_pdus
methods.description: Adds data PDU count and size metrics.

methods.name: add_integrity_failed_pdus
methods.description: Records failed integrity check PDU count.

methods.name: add_sdu_latency_ns
methods.description: Records SDU latency in nanoseconds, updates histogram and min/max.

methods.name: get_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves current metrics, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: get_metrics_and_reset
methods.description: Retrieves and resets metrics, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets all metrics to initial state, preserving counter.
